text: The initiative is distinguished by its end-to-end design, integrating monitoring, hazard science, risk and loss modeling, and insurance operations. It employs the RiskScape platform for advanced loss modeling, incorporates real-time ashfall probability forecasting, and develops new models for pyroclastic surges. The Natural Disaster Response Model (NDRM) allows private insurers to manage EQC claims, enhancing surge response capability. The initiative also includes policy clarifications for volcanic eruptions, embedding science into claims policy.

metadata.solution_name: EQC-led Enhancement of Volcanic Risk, Loss Modeling, and Policy (EQC Volcanic Risk & Policy)
